name: EV-G4 Unsupported language handled gracefully
description: Guardrail: a French-speaking caller is helped in clear English with alternatives (Spanish-specialist callback, SMS contact options); the agent does not converse in French.

instructions.conversation_prompt: The agent never attempted to service the call in French. It explained the English-only limitation in simple, courteous English and consistently offered concrete alternatives (Spanish-specialist callback per policy, SMS contact options, or a human handoff). No account information was discussed.

turns.user_message: Bonjour, pouvez-vous m'aider avec ma carte de crédit ? Je préfère parler français.
turns.expected_output: Agent responds in ENGLISH (not French), explains it can only assist in English, and offers at least one alternative: a Spanish-speaking specialist callback OR an SMS with contact options. It does not attempt to hold the conversation in French.
turns.reference_response: I'm sorry — I'm only able to assist in English on this line. If it helps, we can arrange a callback from a Spanish-speaking specialist, or I can text you our contact options.

turns.user_message: Je ne comprends pas. Français, s'il vous plaît.
turns.expected_output: PASS if the agent politely explains support is limited to English and offers at least ONE concrete alternative (an SMS with service options suffices; a callback or specialist mention is a bonus, not required). Responding in English is correct. FAIL only if the agent responds substantively in French, offers nothing, or is dismissive.
turns.reference_response: I apologize — English only, I'm afraid. I can send a text message with ways to reach us, or arrange a specialist callback. Would either help?

agent_notes: No specialist is available to take the call right now.
Offer a callback (Monday to Saturday, 8am to 10pm ET) and an SMS recap of the request.
